slots.name: felony counts
slots.sentence: Trump has been charged in Manhattan criminal court with 34 felony counts of falsifying business records related to his role in a hush money payment scheme involving adult film actress Stormy Daniels late in the 2016 presidential campaign.

slots.name: plea status
slots.sentence: The former president pleaded not guilty at his April arraignment in Manhattan.

slots.name: hush money payment
slots.sentence: Prosecutors, led by Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg , accuse Trump of falsifying business records with the intent to conceal $130,000 in payments to Daniels made by former Trump attorney and fixer Michael Cohen to guarantee her silence about an alleged affair.
